investment.whyTitle: Why invest in real estate in Paraguay?
investment.whySubtitle: A market with solid fundamentals and unique opportunities in the region.
investment.why1Desc: The Paraguayan real estate market offers 6-12% annual returns, outperforming bank deposits and traditional bonds.
investment.why2Desc: Unlike stocks or crypto, a property is a physical asset that doesn't lose its intrinsic value and appreciates over time.
investment.why3Desc: Paraguay maintains one of the lowest inflation rates in the region, a stable exchange rate and favorable tax policies for investment.
investment.why4Desc: Generate predictable monthly income through renting your property, with high demand in major cities.
investment.why5Desc: Asunción and satellite cities are booming. Investing in new builds today means capturing tomorrow's appreciation.
investment.why6Desc: Compared to other regional markets, Paraguay allows access to quality projects from USD 35,000.

promoters.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before publishing your project.
promoters.faq1Q: How do I publish my project on ProyectPY?
promoters.faq1A: Once you choose your plan and create your account, you access a panel where you can upload all your project information: photos, plans, prices, amenities, location and more. The process takes less than 15 minutes.
promoters.faq2Q: Can I change plans at any time?
promoters.faq2A: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan anytime. The change applies in your next billing cycle and the difference is prorated automatically.
promoters.faq3Q: What type of leads will I receive?
promoters.faq3A: You receive contacts from investors and buyers who are actively looking for new build projects in Paraguay. Each lead includes name, email, phone and the specific project they're interested in.
promoters.faq4A: No. All our plans are monthly and you can cancel anytime without penalty. If you cancel, your account remains active until the end of the paid period.
promoters.faq5Q: Can I integrate ProyectPY with my CRM?
promoters.faq5A: With the Premium plan you have access to our integration API, which allows you to connect leads directly to your CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, etc.) or any tool you use.
promoters.faq6A: Projects from Professional and Premium plans appear first in search results and in the featured section of the homepage. This significantly increases visibility and generated leads.
promoters.faq7Q: What payment methods do you accept?
promoters.faq7A: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), bank transfers and Tigo Money payments. Billing is monthly in USD.
